policy: Only questions represented by a supported family, allowed operation, and the verified business schema catalog may execute.

families.name: stock
limitations: Detail and ranking are deliberately not supported: ITEMSTOCK holds 1-31 rows per item (per mill/HOD), so a non-aggregated read of a single row is not a correct stock answer -- only a SUM per item, matching the ERP's own GETTOTALSTOCK function.
Stock-value (money) is not catalogued, only quantity.

families.name: grn
limitations: "Order pending" as a single yes/no status is not catalogued: the ERP's PO-pending SO/IA/JMD approval ladder (docs/ORACLE_SCHEMA_STUDY_2026-09-22.md §6.1) needs value-pinned compound conditions this catalog does not yet support -- fix.md #4.
GRN.STATUS/FLAG carry no verified meaning and are not exposed.

families.name: mrs
limitations: Department-name lookup is unsupported because no verified MRS-to-department relationship is catalogued.

families.name: consumption
limitations: Issue status meanings are unsupported because status values are not catalogued.
